svg.title: API-level error spike alerts architecture
svg.desc: EventBridge triggers a Lambda every 5 minutes. The Lambda queries New Relic NerdGraph, compares the last 60 minutes with the same window yesterday and last week, and posts CRITICAL and RESOLVED cards to Slack.

g.text: Python 3.12 · lambda_handler · runs once per account
3 NRQL queries per account, run in parallel:
today, the same slices yesterday, and last week
Last 60 min vs the same window yesterday and
last week, as an error rate per API (service + transaction)
Open: rate ≥ 2x the higher reference, ≥ 30 errors,
and not already spiking 5 min ago. Resolve: spike ended
One Slack card per API: CRITICAL or RESOLVED,
with today, yesterday and last-week rates, IST times
Config: Lambda environment variables (API keys, webhooks, thresholds)
Stateless: no database. The current window is compared with the one 5 minutes earlier to avoid duplicate alerts.
